hero.subtitle: A movement and multidisciplinary production house dedicated to sound curation, cultural production, and the creation of spaces for listening, gathering, and artistic development.

manifesto.title: Editorial rigor, underground spirit
manifesto.quote: The project fuses the rigor of a contemporary editorial format with a retro-technology aesthetic. The result is a timeless interface, serious yet with an innovative character, evoking the robustness of analog systems and the classic data archive.
manifesto.p1: Disco Duro is a movement and multidisciplinary production house focused on promoting and distributing music. It operates as a community web radio and an independent creative ecosystem born in Caracas.
manifesto.p2: Dedicated to sound curation, cultural production, and the creation of spaces — digital and physical — for listening, gathering, and the artistic development of a community that doesn't fit the commercial mold.
